steps.say: **Rename** changes what this school or group is called everywhere it appears. Tapping it opens a field holding the current name.

Type the new name and tap **Save**. Nothing else moves — the same people, classes and links carry on underneath it. If the new name matches something sitting beside it you are warned and asked to confirm.
steps.terminal: That's a new name and nothing else changed. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
